## Appearance

Una is a ten-year-old child with a thin little body and tiny hands who has never been very strong. Though not pretty, she has a pale little face with hollow eyes and wistful, almond-shaped dark-blue eyes. Her straight, dead-black hair is styled in braids and can be brushed until it is smooth as satin.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P7](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0007), [v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ## Personality

Una is a sweet, dreamy, and timid child who possesses a tender heart and a sensitive soul. She hates fighting, is prone to shyness, and feels deeply affected by public opinion. She longs to have music lessons and desires to put things right in her household. Additionally, she enjoys praying and harbors a deep fear that a stepmother might cause her father to hate her and her siblings.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P7](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0007), [v5 CHAPTER IV. ## History

Una Meredith lived in [Maywater](../codex/places.md#maywater) before moving to [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary, having lost her mother when she was six years old. In [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary, Una and her siblings quickly bonded with the [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) children after meeting them in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley). When the Meredith children discovered a runaway orphan named [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) in a barn, Una helped arrange a bed for her in the garret and comforted her when she cried. Encouraged by [Nan Blythe](../character/nan-blythe.md), Una later visited [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) to ask if she would adopt Mary, which [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) accepted. Following a warning from Mary about their father possibly remarrying, Una became terrified of getting a stepmother. To improve their behavior and protect their father's reputation, Una and her siblings joined the [Good-Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#good-conduct-club). During a club-mandated day of fasting, Una fainted during a church service, leaving her father overcome with guilt. Despite her deep fear of stepmothers, Una eventually visited [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) to ask her to marry her father for his happiness, receiving reassurances of friendship from [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) and delivering a note that restored her father's spirits.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P26](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0026), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P37](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0037), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P45](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0045), [v5 CHAPTER IV. ## Quotes

> "And I just love those dear Blythes. It’s so nice when you can love people because so often you can’t. Father said in his sermon last Sunday that we should love everybody. But how can we? How could we love Mrs. Alec Davis?"
>
> — Una Meredith — [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P60](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0060)

> "Oh, Mary, it’s just father’s way. Most of the time he never sees us, either. He is thinking deeply, that is all. And I am going to pray that God will keep you in Four Winds—because I like you, Mary."
>
> — Una Meredith — [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS CORNELIA INTERVENES P50](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0050)

> "Aunt Martha never makes any. But Miss Susan at Ingleside does, and sometimes she lets us have a plateful in Rainbow Valley. Do you know what I do when I’m hungry for doughnuts and can’t get any, Mrs. Elliott?"
>
> — Una Meredith — [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P35](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0035)

> "But God put it into her heart to take you. All my putting it into her head wouldn’t have done any good if He hadn’t."
>
> — Una Meredith — [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P69](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0069)

> "Oh, no, no, Mary. I’m sure it couldn’t be right to pray to the devil. And it wouldn’t do any good because he’s bad. It might aggravate him and he’d be worse than ever."
>
> — Una Meredith — [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P75](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0075)

## Relationships

### [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/blythe--una-meredith.md)

Una and the other Meredith children first met the [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) family in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), where they shared cooked trout and quickly became sworn friends and allies. Their shared time involves spending evenings together outdoors, discussing local gossip, and supporting each other through home life and community scandals. Una occasionally feels self-conscious around the [Blythes](../codex/factions.md#blythes), such as feeling envious and shabby when compared to others during their gatherings.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P37](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0037), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P45](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0045), +12 more_

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--una-meredith.md)

Dr. [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) serves as the local physician for Una and her family. ### [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/john-meredith--una-meredith.md)

[John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) is Una's father, a minister who is often deeply absorbed in his studies and distracted from his pastoral and domestic duties. Because of his absentmindedness, Una experiences severe neglect, at one point fainting from a strict self-imposed fast without his initial realization. Despite his shortcomings, John deeply cares for Una and refuses to allow other townspeople to adopt her, though Una lives in constant fear that he might remarry and bring home a stepmother.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P80](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0080), [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P85](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0085), [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P86](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0086), +11 more_
